post.summary: Create or replay an immutable artifact replication plan
post.description:
Newly accepted plans persist both the immutable source coordinate and
digest; neither field may be present without the other. A request-time
quarantine denial returns 403 without creating a plan. If the final
worker check instead observes quarantine, it parks the existing plan
without publishing target metadata. After release, replaying the exact
request with the same Idempotency-Key requeues and returns that plan; it
does not create a second plan. A PyPI source version whose file membership
changes after enqueue is likewise parked with
`replication_snapshot_changed`; exact replay atomically refreshes that
plan's checkpoints before requeueing the same plan ID.

200.description:
Replication plans involving this repository. Coordinate and digest
are both present for current plans and both absent only on historical
plans created before immutable identity persistence was introduced.

Replication plan and checkpoint progress for this repository.
Coordinate and digest are both present for current plans and both
absent only on historical plans created before immutable identity
persistence was introduced. A new worker fails closed rather than
publishing a non-terminal historical plan with both fields absent.

delete.summary: Cancel a pending or failed replication plan
delete.description:
Stops a pending or failed replication plan from being claimed again. A
running plan cannot be cancelled because the worker owns it mid-flight;
such a request fails with 409. Completed and already-cancelled plans are
also not cancellable. The plan record is retained for audit.

post.summary: Requeue failed artifact intelligence copy jobs
post.description: Requeues up to 100 failed or cancelled intelligence copy jobs for this repository. Running, pending, retrying, and completed jobs are left unchanged. Candidate selection and state reset are atomic.

Returns visible, locally resolvable canonical coordinate and digest pairs that can be submitted directly to scanning or distribution operations. Uncached Proxy metadata is excluded. The protocol layer owns coordinate construction. Conan scan results include recipe and package revisions, while distribution results include recipe revisions only.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Canonical Raw path. This is a gateway catch-all parameter and may contain one or more slash-separated segments; empty, dot, dot-dot, and percent-encoded segments are rejected.

get.description: Returns Raw bytes for a file path. `.sha256` and `.sha512` suffixes return a derived lowercase hexadecimal checksum plus newline. When the catch-all path ends in `/`, it instead returns a lexicographically ordered listing of visible Hosted assets below that canonical prefix; `n` and `last` control pagination. With an `uploadId`, returns no content and the current Upload-Offset for an open resumable upload rather than artifact bytes.

200.description: Raw bytes or a Raw directory-prefix JSON page

put.description: Standard Raw Hosted write. The request body is stored directly under the canonical Raw path; no management publish session is used for Raw. A `.sha256` or `.sha512` target validates that checksum against an existing primary object and returns no content without storing a sidecar asset. With `uploadId` and `complete=1`, appends any final bytes, requires a `Digest: sha-256=<base64>` header, and atomically publishes the resumable upload.

201.description: Stored and immediately addressable at this Raw path

post.description: Starts an atomically invisible Raw Hosted upload. This operation requires `resumable=1`; the returned Location contains the opaque uploadId.

patch.description: Appends bytes to an open Raw upload session. Upload-Offset must equal the current offset and the response returns the next offset.

delete.description: Deletes a committed Raw asset. With an `uploadId`, cancels the corresponding open resumable upload and discards its staged bytes.

parameters.name: assetPath
parameters.description: Canonical Maven asset path: groupId path, artifactId, version, and filename. This is a gateway catch-all parameter; only committed POMs, component assets, checksums, and generated metadata are readable.

put.description: Standard Maven/Gradle deploy upload. The Gateway derives coordinate and verified object facts from this request and stages it only. Client checksum sidecars are assertions and client metadata is a compatibility no-op; the Gateway generates both from committed coordinates.

201.description: Staged or idempotently replayed; not readable until coordinate commit

post.description: Called by the Gateway Maven/Gradle publisher extension after normal deploy uploads. It is the only Maven coordinate visibility signal; request ordering, client checksums, client metadata, and quiet time are never completion signals.

resourcePrefix.description: Optional canonical resource prefix. Empty or omitted grants repository-wide access.

enabled.description: Whether scheduled and manual retention execution is enabled.

keepDays.description: Days to retain artifacts or versions before cleanup eligibility.

snapshotKeepDays.description: Days to retain Maven SNAPSHOT versions. Defaults to keepDays when omitted.

minimumVersions.description: Minimum newest versions protected per Maven module, OCI image, Conan reference, npm package, or normalized PyPI project. Raw paths do not use version-count rules.

maximumVersions.description: Maximum versions retained per Maven module, OCI image, Conan reference, npm package, or normalized PyPI project. Zero disables the count cap; Raw paths do not use it.

coordinatePatterns.description: Optional RE2 regular expressions selecting cleanup units. They match Maven coordinates, OCI names or references, Conan references or revisions, Raw paths, npm package names or package versions, and PyPI project names or project versions.

protectedPatterns.description: RE2 regular expressions protecting matching format-specific cleanup units from cleanup.

primaryBytes.description: Cached primary artifact bytes when the repository exposes cache projections.

sidecarBytes.description: Cached metadata and checksum sidecar bytes.

expiredObjectCount.description: Expired cache entries eligible for reclamation.

reclaimableBytes.description: Expired cached bytes eligible for reclamation.

coordinate.description: Immutable artifact coordinate. Omitted together with digest for legacy plans created before artifact identity was persisted.

digest.description: Immutable artifact digest. Omitted together with coordinate for legacy plans created before artifact identity was persisted.

lastError.description: Worker failure text. Parked plans use artifact_quarantined or replication_snapshot_changed as stable control reasons.

CreatePublishSession.description: Maven-only management publish session. Raw Hosted writes use PUT /raw/{repository}/{path}; OCI Hosted writes use Registry V2 upload and manifest routes.

CommitMavenCoordinate.description: Expected names detect incomplete upload only. Digest, size, checksum, metadata, object keys, and visibility are derived and controlled by the Gateway.

authorizationSource.description: Optional bounded authorization decision source. Current values include repository_grants, legacy_static, legacy_protocol, and administrator; consumers must accept future bounded values.

authorizationReason.description: Optional bounded authorization decision reason. Current values include scope_not_granted and grant_lookup_failed; consumers must accept future bounded values.

version.description: Exact package version when the format exposes one independently from the coordinate.

versionCount.description: Number of versions represented by a package-level browse result.

cachedAt.description: Most recent successful cache fill or metadata revalidation time.

sourceUrl.description: Exact upstream URL persisted when this proxy asset was cached.

buildNumber.description: Snapshot build number; zero for release coordinates.

publisher.description: Publisher actor when the format records it.

matchKind.description: Whether this result matched a coordinate prefix or an exact digest.

searchedRepositories.description: Number of readable active repositories considered by this query.

EgressProxy.description: Per-Proxy-Repository egress network proxy configuration. Only meaningful when the repository type is proxy. `password` is accepted on write (plaintext over TLS) and stored AES-256-GCM encrypted; responses never return it and carry `credentialsConfigured` instead.

mode.description: direct bypasses any proxy (keeping private-address protection); environment follows process HTTP(S)_PROXY/NO_PROXY; custom uses the per-repository proxy below.

protocol.description: Custom proxy protocol. http uses CONNECT; socks5 supports optional remote DNS.

host.description: Custom proxy hostname or IP, without scheme or credentials.

password.description: Optional proxy authentication password. Write-only; stored encrypted. Omit on update to keep stored credentials.

clearCredentials.description: When true on update, removes any stored proxy credentials.

remoteDns.description: socks5 only. When true the proxy resolves the upstream hostname (socks5h); when false the gateway resolves locally and keeps the private-address check.

noProxy.description: Upstream host suffixes or CIDR ranges that bypass the custom proxy and connect directly. Matched against the upstream host, never the proxy host.

credentialsConfigured.description: True when encrypted proxy credentials are stored.

UpdateRepository.description: Editable repository management policy and proxy configuration. Hosted repositories only accept anonymousRead updates; name, format, and type are immutable after creation.

endpoint.description: Upstream base URL (https). Required for proxy repositories.

allowedHosts.description: Hosts the proxy may egress to. Required for raw, conan, and npm proxies. npm tarball redirects are limited to this list.

anonymousRead.description: Anonymous read policy. Defaults to false and permits unauthenticated protocol GET/HEAD where effective policy allows it.

EgressProxyTestResult.description: Ephemeral result of an egress proxy connection test. Nothing is persisted.

proxyHost.description: Custom proxy host (no credentials) when mode is custom.

upstreamStatus.description: HTTP status returned by the upstream probe, when reached.

error.description: Sanitized failure reason when reachable is false.

QuarantineReadPolicy.description: Hosted repository policy controlling protocol reads of quarantined artifacts. It is disabled by default.

artifactScanning.description: True when a scanner is configured for this repository format and its assets can be resolved.

publicationScanning.description: True when new publications in this repository can automatically enqueue scanner jobs.

resource.description: Concrete canonical resource evaluated for prefix-scoped grants; empty means repository-wide access.

simulated.description: True when an administrator supplied an actor instead of evaluating the authenticated caller.

coordinate.description: Protocol-owned canonical coordinate accepted by the requested operation.

publisher.description: Publisher actor of the most recent committed publish session for this coordinate. Empty when no publish session was recorded (for example replicated or pre-session artifacts).

buildNumber.description: Snapshot build number. Zero for release coordinates; one or greater for each published build of a SNAPSHOT coordinate.

publisher.description: Publisher actor of the most recent committed publish session for this reference. Empty when no publish session was recorded (for example replicated or pre-session artifacts).

conan.description: Conan 2 supports Group/Proxy read-through and native Hosted resolution under the existing /conan/v2 route family. Hosted publication uses the repository management publish-session contract; lifecycle operations use the native Hosted revision routes, while indexed reference browse/search is exposed through the versioned management API.
